dialog: Judge Eiki Shiki will now preside over your case.
I'll judge this situation myself.
Let's fight fairly.
Stop right there!
I have some words for you.
Everyone is equal before the law in my eyes.
You must show good conduct.
Your ways are mistaken!
One should know one's own sins.
Know your own sins!
You need to be disciplined.
There is none without sin...
So you've stopped running.
You mustn't try to flee.
Let's begin the preliminary hearing...
The defendant will take their seat.
The judgment of a Yama...
should be taken to heart!
This is the light of judgment.
Atone for your sins!
Be purified by this light!
Be purified by this light!
The light of judgment...
let it be seared into your memory!
You cannot escape this verdict.
I call you to the place of judgment.
Regrets...
Reflections...
Change your ways!
Now/ it is time for the Ten Kings' judgment!
Your sentence...
is damnation!
Let there be judgment!
You are summoned to appear before the court.
The sins you have committed...
The karmic burdens you have accrued...
These cannot be atoned for!
Now/ I will sentence you in the name of the Ten Kings.
Your sentence...
will be the maximum penalty!
This is the verdict of the Yama!
This is the verdict of the Yama!
My all-considering judgments...
My all-considering judgments...
cannot be overturned!
Now/ I will sentence you in the name of the Ten Kings.
Your sentence...
is damnation!
Let us commence your final judgment.
The sins written upon my Rod of Remorse...
You will know punishments equal to their number!
I/ Eiki Shiki...
shall burn away each and every one of your sins!
And yet from the scorched earth will further sins bloom...
I shall be your judge!
The sins written upon my Rod of Remorse...
You will know punishments equal to their number!
And now...
It's time for your judgment.
You'd best show remorse now.
I'll be starting your lecture soon/ so prepare yourself.
I shall be seeing to your lecture later.
Resorting to unprincipled methods/ are we?
One can't call this a fair trial.
I will bring them to account for this sin.
I shall assist you!
Eiki Shiki will provide you with support.
One shouldn't leave one's task unfinished.
I won't turn a blind eye to such misdeeds.
We mustn't give up here.
I won't let you get away with this!
I'll provide assistance.
You've shown good judgment.
Don't worry/ I've got my eyes on you.
One should always ascertain the status of the battle first.
Well then/ let's do just as we rehearsed.
I'll teach you a lesson or two here.
You mustn't be too rough with them.
I would like you to see this judgment through.
You and I shall begin their trials.
Let us begin our judgments here.
Yukari Yakumo/ should I take this as a good deed...?
Yukari Yakumo/ I shall assist you.
Yukari Yakumo/ I'll be watching you.
One really should at least try to dodge/ you know.
Yukari Yakumo/ please try more seriously to avoid attacks.
I see that you are taking your time in assessing the battle.
Is it difficult to fight while someone watches you? Good.
Yukari Yakumo/ I'll be watching you.
I shall follow Yukari Yakumo's judgment in this.
Let's get going/ Yukari Yakumo.
The meaning of my judgment is well-known to Yukari Yakumo.
Yukari Yakumo/ I would have you assist me in this prosecution.
Yukari Yakumo/ we'll now be handing down judgment.
I can't believe she'd show such praiseworthy conduct...
Komachi/ let's not be slacking off.
Komachi/ there are still enemies left.
I see no reason to be sparing in coming to my subordinate's aid.
Komachi/ you must pay more attention.
Komachi/ you mustn't slack off now.
I'll leave them in your custody/ Komachi.
Try not to be too rough with them/ Komachi.
Komachi/ I leave it up to your judgment.
Come along/ Komachi/ we have work to do.
Komachi/ transport the defendant over to me.
Let's show them how we do it at the Ministry of Right and Wrong.
Komachi and I shall begin the trial right here.
Yuuka Kazami/ should I take this as a good deed...?
Yuuka Kazami/ there are still enemies left.
Yuuka Kazami/ I'll be watching you.
One really should at least try to dodge/ you know.
Yuuka Kazami/ please try more seriously to avoid attacks.
Is it difficult to fight while someone watches you? Good.
Yuuka Kazami/ I'll be watching you.
Try not to be too rough with them/ Yuuka... I say in vain.
I leave it up to your judgment/ Yuuka Kazami.
Let's get going/ Yuuka Kazami.
The meaning of my judgment is well-known to Yuuka Kazami.
Yuuka Kazami/ I would have you assist me in this prosecution.
Yuuka Kazami/ we will hand down judgment here.
I have no intention of accepting counterarguments that easily.
My judgment never falters.
Let's put a stop to this danmaku.
I have no intention of accepting counterarguments that easily.
My judgment cannot be swayed.
Your danmaku won't hit me.
Do you think you can succeed with such a half-hearted attempt?
I see no need to go easy on those who fear judgment.
Holding back won't change your sentence.
That you've at least managed to hit me is praise-worthy.
That attack is quite lackluster―you do know that/ right?
This is beneath the dignity of a Yama...
I must plan out my next moves...
You've managed to put me on the defensive...
I can't say I dislike facing a skilled opponent.
Even this can't sway my judgment!
I can't let myself be defeated here.
To think that you could manage to obstruct me...
I'm going to remember your behavior here!
I can't believe I couldn't evade that...
Even someone as good-natured as me can be angered/ you know!
So my movements were read in advance...
If this is how it is to be/ then I'll do likewise!
You've shown yourself to be quite capable.
Well/ one could call that admirably enthusiastic/ at least.
... How amusing of you.
I shall not falter in the face of this!
I still haven't been defeated yet!
Well/ I do appreciate how straightforward your attack was/ but...
I hold this sort of behavior in contempt.
You won't be able to accomplish anything with just enthusiasm.
It seems like you're getting agitated.
That needed to be thought out a little better.
If you're going to attack/ do it properly!
This will be added to the lecture.
There's no way that could hit me.
A futile attempt.
No matter how many times you try/ the results will be the same.
Being too moderate when attacking isn't a virtue.
At least try making a slightly more credible attack!
My defenses aren't that easy to defeat.
I won't hear this opinion of yours.
I call on this for my defense.
You can't expect to succeed with such an indecisive attitude.
You think too highly of yourself!
The defendant will be seated!
I shall make the first argument.
You've let yourself grow too slow!
I must confess—you're strong...
In that case/ I must concede defeat...
Well done. I have no further arguments.
We've spoken enough/ let's adjourn.
I did not expect that I would lose.\n I suppose I will have to rely on the others.
I have no further arguments.\n It's unfortunate/ but I will concede defeat.
I can keep lecturing for as long as it takes.
This is quite troublesome/ but as you have no intention of listening...
I have plenty to lecture YOU about.
I would like you to give way to us as soon as practicable.
Your ways are mistaken!
So you intend to add even more to your karma?
Soon the time for us to speak via Danmaku will be over.
I have plenty to lecture YOU about!
Dreams should stay a personal matter.
On behalf of Gensokyo/ I will hand down judgment!
I have plenty to lecture YOU about!
Dreams should stay a personal matter.
On behalf of Muwatari Makura/ I will hand down judgment!
